portada.descripcion: Cultural heritage of Huamanga, Ayacucho. This page checks live that the frontend, the API and the infrastructure are connected.
portada.sinConexionAyuda: Check that Docker is running and the backend is up at {url}.
portada.tesis: Thesis: «Web application for publishing information on the cultural heritage of Ayacucho, 2026».

login.descripcion: Sign in to save favourites, write reviews and stamp your heritage passport.

registro.descripcion: Exploring the heritage requires no account. You need one to save favourites, review places and collect stamps.
registro.ayudaContrasena: At least 8 characters, with uppercase, lowercase and a number.

admin.sinPermisos: Your account does not have administration permissions.

lugares.descripcion: Temples, museums, viewpoints and craft workshops in Huamanga. Search, filter and find out when they open and how far they are on foot.
lugares.buscarPlaceholder: Search by name, history or description
lugares.sinResultados: We found no places matching those criteria. Try another word or remove a filter.
lugares.sinTraduccion: This entry is not translated into your language yet; we are showing it in Spanish.

mapa.descripcion: Explore Huamanga in 3D: temples, museums and viewpoints placed on the terrain, with themed routes and links to get there.

mapa.abrirEnAyuda: Opens in an external navigation app

clima.obsoleto: Latest available reading, taken {cuando}. The weather service is not responding right now.

consejo.lluvia: Bring a raincoat: the courtyards of the colonial temples are open to the sky.
consejo.tormenta: There is a thunderstorm: avoid viewpoints and high ground.
consejo.frioMadrugada: Early mornings are cold at altitude; wrap up if you head out early.
consejo.hidratacion: Drink water often: at 2,761 m you dehydrate before you feel thirsty.
consejo.protectorSolar: Wear sunscreen. At altitude the radiation is strong even when it is not hot.
consejo.uvAlto: High UV at this hour: hat and sun protection.
consejo.vientoFuerte: Strong wind is blowing; take care at the viewpoints.
consejo.atardecerMirador: Good time to head up to a viewpoint for the sunset.

recomendaciones.descripcion: Suggestions based on the time, the weather and what is open right now.
recomendaciones.nadaAbierto: Nothing is open at this hour. Most of Huamanga's heritage opens in the morning; come back tomorrow or plan your visit by date.

proximidad.buscando: We will let you know when you reach a heritage site.
